svg.title: Skills and experience
svg.desc: Manuel's professional foundation, integrations, testing, AI-assisted work, hosting and creative skills, with explicit experience context. Skills & experience. Development, automation, self-hosting and visual work. Betriebsinformatiker EFZ, Novartis apprenticeship, 2016–2020. Web development PHP · Yii · Vue · JavaScript · HTML/CSS Around five years with PHP. Backends, APIs and Vue interfaces for business tools and personal projects. Data & integrations MySQL/MariaDB · REST · OpenAPI Complex SQL, database design, API integrations and data synchronisation. Testing & quality Cypress · E2E testing End-to-end flows, regression coverage and failure analysis for web applications. AI workflows & products Codex · Claude Code · Skills · Agents Experienced with AI workflows. My React, TypeScript and tRPC products are built with AI support. Hosting & tooling Linux · nginx · Docker · Git A rented root server with my own nginx configurations. Practical basics in Git and Docker. Design & media Photography · Lightroom · Photoshop Graphic and web design, photo editing and video editing with DaVinci Resolve. Also Canva and GIMP.
